profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Its website describes an AI music generator that creates complete original songs, including vocals, lyrics, and production, from a single text prompt in under a minute. The site says users can describe a genre, mood, theme, or their own lyrics and then regenerate, extend, or refine the result.

The company describes Suno Studio as a web-based generative audio workstation that combines traditional DAW functionality with AI-powered music creation. The site outlines a free tier and paid plans. The Pro plan includes 500 songs a month, access to v5.5, commercial use rights, the Song Editor, stem separation, and audio uploads of up to 8 minutes. The Premier plan includes 2,000 songs a month, Suno Studio, a multitrack editor, MIDI export, Persona Voices, and early access to new features.

Court records list twelve cases naming Suno as a defendant across five federal districts, including UMG Recordings, Inc. v. Suno, Inc. in the District of Massachusetts and cases brought by Beckham, Lowery, Gerencia 360 Music, Round Hill Music, Gawronski, Rugnetta, Pilavian, Reyna, S.A. Jamendo, Poseidon Wave Media, and Woulard. Massachusetts records list 191 matters involving Suno.
